Name: Magnolia - A new M. Rasmodius for your game
Author: JohnnyDoRock
Description:
[b]Rasmodius now is Magnólia, the new lesbian [/b][i](or not, if you're a man) [/i][b]witch in the valley! 

[/b]In the start, I made Magnólia as a personal project, seeing that my farmer is kinda like an OC now, and is married to Magnólia. Tho, as I could not found in my searches an older Wizard that was a woman, I thought that I could give the others what I didn't found, so here we are. Now you can download her too!

[b][i][u]Big alert: 
[/u][/i][/b]I don't know how to do the coding stuff, so you need "Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE" ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]), "Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic" ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]) or any other mod that changes the Wizard's portrait, so you can overwrite the image. Sorry about that, already trying to fix it.

My thanks go to my friends that thought she was pretty too and to my kinda boring college classes that made me inspired to do so much for a simple ideia.



Know everything, but in Portuguese

[b]O Rasmodius agora é a Magnólia, a nova lésbica [/b][i](ou não, se tu for um homem) [/i][b]bruxa do vale!

[/b]No começo, eu fiz dona Magnólia só como um projeto pessoal, tendo em mente que minha fazendeira virou tipo uma OC, que é casada com a Magnólia. Entretanto, já que nas minhas pesquisas eu não consegui achar nenhum mod que fosse o mago mulher mais velha, eu achei que seria top dar aos outros a oportunidade de achar. E cá estamos. Agora você pode a baixar também!

[b][i][u]Alertão pra ti:
[/u][/i][/b]Não sei fazer a parte de programação ainda, então você precisa de "Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE" ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]), "Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic" ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]) ou qualquer outro mod que mude o retrato do Mago pra você dar overwrite na imagem. Perdão, já tô trabalhando pra mudar isso.

Meus agradecimentos vão aos meus amigos que também acharam ela bonita e as minhas aulas da faculdade meio chatas que me inspiraram a fazer tanto por uma simples ideia.

Please don't repost and ask if you want to make public changes - Por favor não reposte e pergunte se quiser fazer mudanças públicas
